label: theme
tooltip: Set Blender UI theme and HDRI values, plus Place Picture fake gizmos and fake grid over a background image.

children.label: Browse
children.tooltip: Choose a theme source image and sample its colors into the tool fields.

children.label: Absorb Theme
children.tooltip: Pull the current Blender theme values back into the tool fields.

children.label: Save Buckets
children.tooltip: Save the currently staged Blender theme buckets.

children.label: Load Buckets
children.tooltip: Load saved Blender theme buckets into the tool fields.

children.label: Dark Theme
children.tooltip: Stage the sampled palette as a dark Blender theme.

children.label: Light Theme
children.tooltip: Stage the sampled palette as a light Blender theme.

children.label: Apply
children.tooltip: Apply the currently visible Blender theme role colors.

children.label: Place Picture
children.tooltip: Creates fake gizmos and a fake grid on top of a background image.

children.label: Grid
children.tooltip: Apply near and far grid spacing using the world-origin distance threshold.

children.label: Browse
children.tooltip: Choose the Place Picture background image path.

children.label: Startup
children.tooltip: Save the current Place Picture image so Blender restores it on startup.

children.label: Clear
children.tooltip: Remove the Place Picture fake background, grid, and gizmos while keeping the path field.

children.label: HDRI Apply
children.tooltip: Apply the HDRI path in the field.

children.label: Clear
children.tooltip: Reset the current file to a plain world without the staged HDRI.

children.label: Reset
children.tooltip: Rebuild a clean world and reapply the staged HDRI values.

children.label: HDRI Browse
children.tooltip: Choose the HDRI file path.

children.label: Z
children.tooltip: Apply the staged Z rotation value.

children.label: Y
children.tooltip: Apply the staged Y rotation value.

children.label: X
children.tooltip: Apply the staged X rotation value.

children.label: WS
children.tooltip: Apply the staged world strength value.

children.label: Migrate Profiles
children.tooltip: Import declared legacy tone profiles into this installed Theme owner.

children.label: Save Package
children.tooltip: Save the staged theme fields and copied image assets as a portable package.

children.label: Open Package
children.tooltip: Open a saved theme package and restore its staged fields and copied image assets.

children.label: Previous
children.tooltip: Load the previous saved theme package.

children.label: Next
children.tooltip: Load the next saved theme package.

children.label: Apply Bucket
children.tooltip: Apply one manifest-selected theme role through the package runtime.
